newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds dip on US trade data,focus on Germany.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds dip on US trade data,focus on Germany.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened lower on Thursday, hit by U.S. trade data and dealers said the market was focused on upcoming German Ifo business climate and M-3 money supply data for a boost.
"Wednesday's better than expected U.S. March trade data hit Wall Street, which rubbed off on us, dragging prices down," one dealer explained.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 had fallen 0.46 point from Wednesday's close to 110.74 at 0725 gmt, with the upcoming seven percent 2007 benchmark 0.51 point down at 103.26.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 68 basis points. The crown stood at an unchanged 3.8070 per mark.
